name: Caygri Checkout Fields for FluentCart
author: caygri

sections.description:
Caygri Checkout Fields for FluentCart is an independent extension that allows store owners to add up to two extra text fields to the checkout of websites using FluentCart.

This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially developed by the FluentCart team.

It is useful for simple checkout requirements such as:

  • VAT number
  • SDI code
  • Tax code
  • Customer notes for invoicing
  • Internal reference fields

The fields can be managed from WordPress admin and are saved to both the order and customer data when available.

Features

  • Add up to two extra checkout fields
  • Configure label, field name and placeholder
  • Mark fields as required or optional
  • Show saved data inside the order detail page
  • Save data to order and customer metadata when supported

Upgrade to PRO

Need advanced checkout functionality?

The PRO version includes:

  • Unlimited fields
  • Multiple field types
  • Conditional logic (AND / OR)
  • Drag & drop ordering
  • Dynamic show/hide fields

Learn more:
https://lab.caygri.com/item/fluentcart-extra-fields-pro/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/caygri-checkout-fields-for-fluentcart/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Checkout Fields” in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure your checkout fields.
  5. Test the checkout with a new order.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require FluentCart?

Yes. This plugin is designed to work with websites using FluentCart.

Is this an official FluentCart plugin?

No. This plugin is an independent extension by Caygri and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially developed by the FluentCart team.

How many fields can I add?

This version supports up to two simple text fields.

Where are the field values saved?

Values are saved to order metadata and, when available, to customer metadata.

Can I make fields required?

Yes. Each field can be set as required or optional.
